title: Server options
subtitle: They apply to every computer connected to this one.
clipboard.label: Share the clipboard
clipboard.hint: Copy on one computer and paste on another.
switchDelay.label: Wait at the edge before switching
switchDelay.hint: Prevents switching by accident when the mouse brushes the edge.
doubleTap.label: Switch only on a double tap at the edge
doubleTap.hint: You have to move the mouse to the edge twice in a row.
group.lock: Lock the mouse to one screen
lockKey.label: Scroll Lock locks the mouse to the current screen
lockKey.hint: Useful for games or full-screen programs.
startLocked.label: Start with the mouse locked
relativeMoves.label: Relative mouse movement
relativeMoves.hint: For 3D games that capture the mouse.
heartbeat.label: Check that the computers are still connected
heartbeat.hint: Reconnects sooner if one stops responding.
protocol.label: Compatibility
keepForeground.label: Don’t steal the active window
keepForeground.hint: When you come back to this computer, the window you were using stays in front.
saved.running: Saved. Deskflow restarted to apply it.
saved.stopped: Saved. It takes effect the next time you start Deskflow.
